description: Residents parking schemes in force is a dataset listed in Open Data Bristol, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Bristol City Council. This dataset shows the geographic extent of areas within Bristol where residents may apply for parking permits. Includes Resident Parking Scheme areas. Coverage: Bristol. The portal files it under Transport & Streets. Its keywords are local information, Parking, Parking permits, CPZ. The portal shows 19 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-05-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-bristol-gov-uk-portal.
